items.text: South African jurist Navi Pillay is awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.
Henri B. Kagan and Kensō Soai are awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.
Francis Halzen is awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work in neutrino astronomy.
